description: This Java class 'TestData' provides utility methods to generate sample data for a book tracking application, including authors, books, publishers, tags, and predefined shelves, with randomization for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestData
classes.description: Utility class for generating sample book-related data with randomization for testing purposes.

methods.name: generateRandomNumberInRange
methods.description: Generates a random integer between 300 and 1000 inclusive.

methods.name: generateAuthors
methods.description: Creates a list of predefined authors.

methods.name: generateBooks
methods.description: Generates a list of books with randomized attributes based on provided authors, tags, shelves, and publishers.

methods.name: generatePublishers
methods.description: Creates a list of predefined publishers.

methods.name: generateListOfTags
methods.description: Creates a list of predefined tags.

methods.name: createBook
methods.description: Creates a Book object with randomized attributes based on input parameters.

methods.name: setPredefinedShelfForBooks
methods.description: Assigns predefined shelves to a list of books and sets reading status and ratings accordingly.
